name: AI-News-Tweet-Agent
headline: AI-News-Tweet-Agent: Social Media
short_description: We build custom AI skills and automations for B2B companies.
author: kartikbansode

sections.overview: The AI-News-Tweet-Agent is an innovative AI-powered social media bot designed to automate the process of sharing news and updates on platforms like Twitter. This Claude Code skill leverages artificial intelligence to curate relevant content, allowing users to maintain an active online presence without the constant need for manual input. By automating tweet generation, this skill helps marketers and social media managers streamline their workflow and focus on strategic initiatives rather than repetitive tasks. One of the key benefits of the AI-News-Tweet-Agent is its ability to save time and enhance engagement. While the exact time savings are currently unknown, users can expect to significantly reduce the hours spent on content curation and posting. This skill is particularly beneficial for those in marketing roles who need to keep their audience informed and engaged with the latest industry news. By utilizing this AI automation, teams can ensure a consistent flow of information, which is crucial for maintaining audience interest and driving interaction. The AI-News-Tweet-Agent is best suited for marketers, product managers, and AI practitioners looking to enhance their social media strategies. This skill is particularly relevant for those who operate in fast-paced environments where timely communication is essential. Practical use cases include automating daily news tweets, sharing updates about product launches, or even promoting blog posts, all of which can be executed with minimal effort once the skill is implemented. With an intermediate level of complexity and a relatively quick implementation time of just 30 minutes, the AI-News-Tweet-Agent is accessible to users with a moderate technical background. It fits seamlessly into AI-first workflows, allowing organizations to leverage automation for improved efficiency. As businesses increasingly adopt AI automation, this skill represents a valuable addition to any marketing toolkit, enabling teams to maximize their output while minimizing manual labor.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/kartikbansode/AI-News-Tweet-Agent`
sections.usage:
```
Act as an AI-News-Tweet-Agent for [INDUSTRY]. Monitor [SPECIFIC NEWS SOURCES] for breaking news. When relevant news is found, generate a 280-character tweet that includes the key details, a relevant hashtag, and a call-to-action. Use a conversational tone and avoid jargon. Example: 'Breaking: [INDUSTRY] sees record growth in Q2! 📈 #News #Trends. What does this mean for your business? Comment below!'.
```
Copy

```
Breaking: The electric vehicle market surged 30% in Q2, driven by new models and government incentives! 🚗💨 #EVRevolution #GreenEnergy. How will this impact your fleet strategy? Share your thoughts! 

Source: @IndustryNewsHour - Full report: [link]
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
